subject: Ziggy: category-first jewelry and gun display references for Grok
body:
Ziggy asks you to prepare Grok messages for product-first jewelry and gun reference images, following the tattoo-artwork layout. This paraphrases his direct browser annotations in CFA SITE INDEX.

Use category-first browsing: Tattoos, Grills, Piercings and jewelry, Guns. Character-specific ownership and wearing examples belong one level inside, not in parallel top-level Dolo sections. Grills is one group with one clear image per design; its Hon cover is the selected natural-mouth close-up.

For Piercings and jewelry, request standalone pieces on a pillow or in a display case, leading the collection; actor images are secondary placement examples. Prioritize the favorite dice earring on the less-shown side opposite the neck blaster, and the liked hoop variants on the blaster side. Several designs may be acceptable; about eight was an estimate, not eight identified approvals. Inventory the existing variants and preserve tolerated variation. The map places the blaster on character-left, but verify matching image orientation. LF full and LOCK-FACE show a dark stud with pale pip-like dots opposite the blaster; this is evidence to inspect, not a confirmed exact favorite dice design. Do not invent hidden construction.

For Guns, request standalone visual references for the fictional costume props. Ziggy likes the changing gun designs already shown and allows that variety; do not force one exact gun. Keep actor/outfit examples underneath. The attached PROP-HD-HIP image is the current cover, a body-derived crop, not standalone product artwork.

Prepare exact source-backed Grok requests and return the selected source IDs and proposed output organization. Site Index will intake actual returns without replacing originals or existing reviews. No generation was performed by Site Index.
